title: Molecular complexity on disc scales uncovered by ALMA. Chemical composition of the high-mass protostar AFGL 4176
question: What is the chemical inventory (species, excitation temperatures, column densities, spatial distribution) of the high-mass protostar AFGL 4176 on disk scales, and how does it compare with other sources and hot-core models?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms ~0.5 mJy/beam; 1.5-2.2 mJy/beam per 1.2 km/s channel

what.value: 12C/13C = 60 from galactocentric relation at d_GC = 6.64 kpc

evidence.quote: adopting a $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C values of 60, derived assuming a galactocentric distance ($d_{\textrm{GC}}$) of 6.64 kpc and the relation for $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C reported by (cite: Milam2005)

what.value: Spectroscopic line catalogues JPL and CDMS

evidence.quote: catalogued transition frequencies from the JPL (cite: Pickett1998) and CDMS (cite: Muller2001; Muller2005; Endres2016) molecular databases are compared with the extracted spectra

what.value: Comparison abundances for Sgr B2, Orion KL, IRAS 16293B and Garrod 2013 models

evidence.quote: These studies focus on Sgr B2(N), Orion KL and the low-mass protostellar binary IRAS 16293. We conclude the section with a comparison to chemical models.

recipe.method: Archive pipeline calibration, continuum subtraction, primary-beam correction, separate continuum and line imaging
Spectrum averaged over a beam at the continuum peak; compare with JPL/CDMS; detection if S/N>=3; <5 lines tentative
LTE optically thin synthetic spectra over a grid of Tex and Ns; minimum chi2 best fit; fixed Tex for species with few lines
key_parameters: vLSR = -53.5 km/s, FWHM = 6 km/s fixed; source size = beam; Tex 50-500 K step 10 K
assumptions: LTE, optically thin; fixed Tex = 200 K (average) for poorly constrained species; 12C/13C = 60

recipe.goal: Derive H2 column density and abundances
recipe.method: N(H2) from dust continuum with Planck function at 200 K; ratios to CH3OH from 13CH3OH x 60
assumptions: Gas-to-dust 100, T = 200 K, optically thin dust

recipe.method: Zero and first-moment maps of isolated lines (>=3 km/s from neighbours) at low and high Eup; 2D Gaussian fits to moment-0

recipe.goal: Compare with other sources and models
recipe.method: Compare ratios to CH3OH with Sgr B2, Orion KL, IRAS 16293B and Garrod 2013 models

evidence.quote: The peak continuum emission is 29 mJy beam$^{-1}$ (5.7 K at 247 GHz)
A total of 354 lines are identified towards AFGL 4176 with a signal-to-noise ratio of three or above.
The column density upper limit is $\leq$1.1$\times$10$^{16}$ cm$^{-2}$, equivalent to $\leq$0.2% with respect to methanol.
On average, the column density ratios derived for O-bearing species are a factor of three higher than those derived for N-bearing species.
These are found to be $\sim$16 and $\sim$34, respectively.

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Line-free channels/spectral ranges for the continuum image
Exact spectrum extraction aperture and line selection for moment maps
CASSIS version and exact chi2 definition
Which lines were used for each species fit
missing_for_reproduction: CASSIS version and input line lists per species
Which lines were used per species
score_reason: Public archive data and a clear LTE grid-fit recipe with tabulated results; some imaging and line-selection details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, a clear recipe, and numeric Tex and column density tables.
